Magic Items work like normal Items in the most part, the main difference is that they all have various effect, and sometime curses. And need to be Appraised. 
An Unappraised Magic Item can still be equipped as a regular piece of equipment, along with the bonuses it grants as a weapon or armor, but any special effects will not take effect until the item has been appraised. Furthermore, an unappraised Magic Item can only be sold for 1/4 of tis actual Value.
The exception to the above is if the Magic Item has a Curse effect. In that case, the Curse take effect whether or not the character using the item successfully Appraised it.
A character who appraises an Item must either hold it or be in the Engagement if it is too big to hold. Then, they must attempt an Intelligence Check (Appraise Item). If they succeed, they learn all information about the Item. A character may only attempt to Appraise an Item one time. Whether they fail or succeed, they are not allowed to attempt it again. Instead of Appraising, a character may also choose to pay 1/4 of the Value of the Item to have it Appraised on their behalf. If so treat the Item as if it was successfully Appraised.
